body.statement: Under the two-stage design, \(\mathbb E[\widehat\tau_n]=\tau_n\) and the exact finite-sample variance is \[\sigma_n^2=\frac{R_n}{G_n}+C_{\tau\tau,n}-\frac{C_{11,n}}{G_{1n}}-\frac{C_{00,n}}{G_{0n}}.\] Moreover, \(\mathbb E[\widehat V_{\mathrm{CR2},n}]=(V_{1,n}-C_{11,n})/G_{1n}+(V_{0,n}-C_{00,n})/G_{0n}\), so \(\mathbb E[\widehat V_{\mathrm{CR2},n}]-\sigma_n^2=-C_{\tau\tau,n}\) exactly.
body.justification: The formula separates treatment randomization from the covariance retained by forming groups without replacement and gives an exact finite-sample bias identity for CR2.
body.gap: FuSamiiWang2026, Section 4.1, discards the disjoint-pair covariance under birthday sparsity; its Theorems 1--2 do not state this exact variance or bias formula.
body.consumer: Researchers can diagnose whether a familiar group-level sandwich omits first-order random-partition dependence.
